chunks.rationale: Identity-semantics changes that everything else keys on: threadPatch.ts returns prev when a 700ms tick moved nothing (sameTail guards), Sidebar ThreadCard is memo'd (handleSelect via refs, threadTitles reuses its Map), services.listThreads caches the decorated list on threads/projects array identity (replace-only invariant, verified). A wrong bail = stale UI; a missed bail = O(n) per tick.
risks: listThreads caching rests on a convention: any future in-place mutation of a thread/project row or array silently serves a stale sidebar. The invariant is commented at the cache.
mergeThreadPatch returning prev drops patch.seq — safe only because seq lives on ThreadPatch, not ThreadDetail, and gap detection runs in the caller.
Sidebar handleSelect reads visibleIds/selectAnchor via refs synced in a passive effect — correct for user events, not for synthetic same-tick calls.

risks: A new dev server can take up to ~30s to appear in the Local Servers card (15s poll + 30s main TTL). Deliberate.
codeindex/listThreads/citation caches share parsed objects across callers — all verified read-only today.
